author: CNET
description:
Did you go to an Apple Store today? 👀🍎

CNET Editor at Large Bridget Carey, and other CNET editors and reporters took a trip to their local stores to get a look at the lines for the iPhone Duo launch so you don’t have to. 

We don’t know how many iPhone Duos are available at each store or when Apple will restock its physical locations. But there’s a limit of two iPhone Duos per person, per day, which marks the first time in a long time that Apple’s put a cap on how many you can buy. And yes, some of the stores we went to already sold out. 

Here’s how the day went and how long people were willing to wait to get their hands on this $1,999 first-generation Apple product. #apple #applestore #iphoneduo #onemorething #foldable
